description: Source code for a data plotting module in the BORIS behavioral observation software, including classes for plotting data with real-time updates and GUI components.

classes.name: MyMplCanvas
classes.description: Custom matplotlib canvas for plotting within the GUI.

classes.name: Plot_data
classes.description: Main widget class for plotting external data with interactive controls and real-time updates.

classes.name: Plotter
classes.description: Helper class responsible for replotting data based on current time, emitting signals for plotting.

methods.name: MyMplCanvas.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the matplotlib figure and axes, sets size policy.

methods.name: Plot_data.__init__
methods.description: Sets up the plotting widget, loads data from file, processes it, and initializes plotting thread.

methods.name: Plot_data.eventFilter
methods.description: Handles keypress events to send to main window.

methods.name: Plot_data.zoom
methods.description: Adjusts the zoom level of the plot.

methods.name: Plot_data.timer_plot_data_out
methods.description: Triggers plot update based on current time.

methods.name: Plot_data.update_plot
methods.description: Emits signal to update plot with new data.

methods.name: Plot_data.close_plot
methods.description: Stops plotting thread and closes widget.

methods.name: Plot_data.plot
methods.description: Receives data and updates the plot display.

methods.name: Plotter.replot
methods.description: Calculates data segment to plot based on current time and emits signal for plotting.
